configurations._comment: apps/web, run from the workspace root via the root 'dev' script. Every entry here needs apps/server already serving the API at VITE_API_BASE — vite proxies /api and /health there. With nothing listening the app still renders, but every query fails and practice never produces a problem. No VITE_SUPABASE_* here: the app still boots, but every route past /login redirects back to it (auth is required in both apps, PLAN_BACKEND.md §9) — use 'web-auth' to actually sign in.
configurations.name: web

configurations._comment: The static guided demo (main.tsx swaps in StaticDemoApp for mode=demo). No API and no Supabase — every response is local and deterministic, so this needs nothing else running.
configurations.name: web-demo

configurations._comment: Second dev server on its own port, so a second session can run one while 'web' is already up on 5173.
configurations.name: web-alt

configurations._comment: With Supabase auth enabled, against the local `supabase start` stack's demo project (anon key below is that project's well-known local default, not a secret). Auth is required in both apps now (PLAN_BACKEND.md §9) — there is no single-user/no-auth build any more, so this is the only way to reach anything past /login.
configurations.name: web-auth

configurations._comment: web-auth on an alternate port, for a session where 5173 is already taken by another chat's dev server.
